messages:
anya: Heads-up: noticed Python SDK v1.8.0 sending X-Redwood-Telemetry-Sample header in the canary. Console rollout is at 10% but quota attribution shows a bunch of calls as 'unknown' for some tenants. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: Yup, saw similar in staging this morning. Looks like telemetry sampling is present but quota tags aren't propagating for certain routes.

santiago: Can you paste the exact request headers you observed? quick repro would help.

anya: Sure, here's one example we captured in staging:
```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Telemetry-Sample: 0.1
X-Redwood-RouteHint:
```

kevin: Ah — there's the smoking gun. If RouteHint is empty the console proxy treats it differently. The SDK change tried to avoid leaking route hints but ended up sending an empty header instead of omitting it.

lucy: I can repro with the Go SDK too. Empty header => console policy fallback puts it into the global bucket, and our sampling logic ends up ignoring the telemetry header. Short-term workaround is to omit the header entirely when not set.

anya: @mike can we push a hotfix to the Python SDK to omit X-Redwood-RouteHint when it's empty? Also what is the rollback/mitigation story on the console side if needed?

mike: Yep, will open a PR for py-sdk to omit the header. For console, safer change is to treat empty as missing (CONSEQUENCE: minimal) but that requires a small console deploy and risks during rollout. Plan: patch SDK first, then add a console guard.

santiago: Also adding an opt-out env for the SDK would help critical tenants while we stabilize: e.g. REDWOOD_SDK_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=true to stop sending sampling header at all. That buys time for console patch.

deploy-bot: deploy started: py-sdk v1.8.1-hotfix -> pypi (canary) by @mike — canary: 10% to mkt-orgs — build 4829

kevin: Note for release notes and postmortem: this impacts quota attribution for tenants using `tenant.quota.*` rules. Docs + support blurb needed (how to check 'unknown' vs 'global').

anya: I'll file a console bug/infra ticket (CON-4321) and add an e2e that mirrors the canary org config. Also request a docs blurb. Thanks all :thumbsup:
